title: Erika Swilley:
title_q: “Kids don't have to love the NBA”
title_short: Erika Swilley · Why the players are in it
headline: Kids don't have to love the NBA. It's really about math, and through the game they get to know the players and their stats.
story: Erika runs the National Basketball Players Association's Foundation. She has brought Math Hoops with her from the Warriors to the Pistons to the players' union.
Her point: it is about math, not fandom. Kids learn players' shooting percentages and stats, they get excited about math, and she wants the game in every school.

Loops: L1 “Then why the NBA players?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:11 (“shooting percentages”). L2 “Why does she believe in it?” opens at 0:11 and closes at the button. Stakes: math is not every kid's favorite subject.
do: Open on “Kids don't have to love the NBA” with the hook text already on screen.
Use her SECOND take of the partnership answer (02:59 on), never the first.
Super: Erika Swilley / Executive Director, NBPA Foundation.
Show kids reading player cards on “shooting percentages”.
End on “every single school”, then the Learn more end card.
dont: Never call it the NBA Foundation. She corrects this on camera: she is at the Players Association.
Do not use the matching grant line (it has a dollar amount).
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.
